articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level math and science benchmarks, narrowing the gap to expert human performance on several standardized evaluations. Enterprise API pricing has been restructured to accommodate the heavier compute requirements.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on SWE-Bench Verified and HumanEval-X, successfully resolving over 72% of real-world GitHub issues autonomously. The model integrates tightly with Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform, offering developers tool-use pipelines that can browse documentation, write tests, and submit pull requests. The release intensifies competition with Anthropic and OpenAI in the agentic software engineering space.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Computer Use API for Enterprise Automation
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's computer use capabilities into a production-grade API, allowing enterprises to deploy AI agents that interact with desktop applications, legacy software, and internal tools via structured screen understanding. Early adopters in finance and healthcare report 40-60% reductions in manual back-office workflows. The system includes a new safety layer that requires human-in-the-loop approval for irreversible actions.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Shift with Figure 03 Humanoids
articles.summary: Figure completed a 10-hour fully autonomous warehouse shift at a BMW logistics facility using a team of six Figure 03 humanoid robots performing pick-and-place, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks. The robots coordinated via a shared world model and demonstrated graceful failure recovery, including rerouting tasks when one unit encountered a hardware fault. The milestone marks one of the first commercially viable demonstrations of multi-humanoid collaboration in an unstructured industrial setting.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Toyota Research Institute Unveil Dexterous Manipulation Breakthrough
articles.summary: A joint research effort between Boston Dynamics and the Toyota Research Institute produced a new diffusion-policy-based manipulation system that allows Atlas to perform bi-manual tasks such as assembling small electronic components and threading cables. The system was trained on fewer than 50 human demonstrations per task using sim-to-real transfer with domain randomization. Researchers say the approach generalizes to novel objects with minimal fine-tuning, a long-standing challenge in robotic manipulation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production at its Fab 21 facility in Arizona on the A14 (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around FET process, delivering an estimated 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2. Apple and NVIDIA are reported first customers, with AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs expected to tape out in Q3 2026. The milestone cements TSMC's process leadership and has significant implications for next-generation AI training chip efficiency.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trial in Spinal Cord Injury Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to expand its PRIME clinical trial to include patients with complete spinal cord injuries, allowing participants to control robotic limbs and digital interfaces via the N2 implant. Initial cohort data showed participants achieving cursor control within hours of calibration and rudimentary robotic arm manipulation within two weeks. The expansion represents a significant regulatory milestone for invasive BCI technology moving toward broader therapeutic applications.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under a permissive license allowing commercial use. Independent benchmarks place it competitive with GPT-5 and Gemini Ultra 2 on reasoning and multilingual tasks, while being fully self-hostable on a cluster of eight H200 nodes. The release includes quantized variants, fine-tuning recipes, and safety-tuning datasets, further accelerating the open-weight AI ecosystem.
